jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**About Arena Intelligence**
============================

Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it.

Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do.

We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus.

### **About the Role**

Arena Intelligence is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to help scale and strengthen the core infrastructure that powers real-world AI evaluation. You’ll play a foundational role in shaping how we build, deploy, and improve our model benchmarking systems, working across data pipelines, inference APIs, and new evaluation methodologies. This is an opportunity to apply your technical expertise to a platform trusted by millions, and to help define how cutting-edge AI is assessed in the wild.

As one of the first ML engineers on the team, you’ll partner closely with researchers, engineers, and product leadership to turn new ideas into reliable systems. You’ll help us move fast while staying rigorous, improving reproducibility, scaling up to new modalities, and deepening our ability to understand and compare frontier models.

### **You’ll**

* Architect and build what will become our core modeling for data and evaluation products
* Own the full stack data, model training, and eval pipelines
* Help grow a culture of feedback and rapid product iteration as we build new features as a tight-nit team
* Conduct research into state-of-the-art evaluation methods and contribute to the long-term vision for a centralized, scalable evaluation platform.

### **You’ll have**

* Strong programming skills with the ability to work across the stack in a typical recommendation system or LLM stack
* Experience in deep learning, language models or reward model training
* Experience in working with LLM for fine tuning, prompt engineering, function calling etc
* Self-motivated with a willingness to take ownership of tasks
* A passion for shipping quality products
* 4+ years of industry experience or relevant projects
* Solid understanding of statistics, and various tools and methodologies for evaluating uncertainty in a way that is specific to the given product being shipped

**What we offer**
=================

* We offer competitive compensation aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The compensation range for each role is listed on its posting and will depend on the candidate's experience and work location.
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs.
* The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI with a small, mission-driven team
* A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact

Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI.

Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Machine Learning & Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: *We Before Me*, *Do the Right Thing*, and *Get Things Done*. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

We are looking for a seasoned engineer to build and improve the ML and data infrastructure behind our risk and fraud prevention systems. You will work hands-on to move models from experimentation into reliable production services, improve model execution performance, and develop data pipelines that support training, evaluation, and real-time decisions. You will take ownership of your work, identify improvements proactively, and deliver with limited guidance

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Improve model inference latency, throughput, resource utilization, and cost. Profile the prediction path—from feature retrieval and preprocessing to model execution—and implement measurable improvements while preserving model quality.
* Build and maintain infrastructure for model packaging, versioning, deployment, serving, monitoring, and rollback across cloud platforms and regions.
* Develop and optimize offline data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, and warehouse or lakehouse technologies. Address data modeling, partitioning, joins, shuffles, skew, incremental processing, and cost.
* Work on offline and online feature pipelines, supporting point-in-time correctness, consistent feature definitions, freshness, lineage, and reproducible backfills.
* Build and maintain reliable feature services and data integrations for risk models and decision systems.
* Take ownership of projects and operational issues, communicate progress and tradeoffs, and collaborate with ML, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and product teams.
* Contribute to technical discussions, share knowledge, and help teammates through code reviews and collaboration.

**What We Look For In You**
---------------------------

* Experience building and operating distributed systems, ML infrastructure, or data platforms, with ownership of meaningful production components.
* Hands-on experience improving production model performance, such as latency, throughput, resource utilization, or cost.
* Strong experience with Databricks and Spark, or comparable offline data platforms, including execution plans, distributed query optimization, storage layouts, data correctness, and workload cost management.
* Experience with the model lifecycle, including training and serving integration, validation, deployment, observability, and rollback.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, plus proficiency in at least one backend or systems language such as Java, Scala, Go, or C++.
* Ability to work independently through loosely defined problems, make sound implementation decisions, and deliver maintainable systems with limited guidance.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* SageMaker, Alibaba Cloud PAI/EAS, or comparable ML platforms.
* Inference optimization using tools such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or Triton.
* Delta Lake, MLflow, feature stores, Kafka, Flink, and low-latency data stores.
* Fraud detection or financial risk systems.
* Fluency in Mandarin

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

* Competitive total compensation package
* L&D programs for employees' growth and development
* Various team building programs and company events
* Wellness and meal allowances
* Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
* More that we love to tell you along the process!

**OKX** **Statement:**

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The salary range for this position is $178,888 to $268,333

The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 49277

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

**The team**
------------

The Tooling team builds shared systems that make data reliable, discoverable, governable, efficient, and easy to use. Our work spans data quality, lineage, metadata, ownership, observability, lifecycle management, optimization, and self-service workflows for Data Engineering, Data Science, Experimentation, Machine Learning, and product teams.

**The role**
------------

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate high-leverage data tooling used across Roblox. You will own substantial technical work from problem discovery through production rollout, turning complex operational signals into clear, dependable workflows.

A key focus for this role is intelligent automation for data operations: helping people and systems discover relevant data, diagnose quality or pipeline issues, understand cost and lifecycle signals, and take safe next steps. You will build these capabilities with strong evaluation, observability, and human oversight.

**You will**
------------

* Design, implement, and operate shared services, frameworks, and developer experiences for data quality, lineage, metadata, ownership, observability, lifecycle management, and optimization.
* Turn signals such as freshness, quality failures, lineage, usage, and compute or storage cost into actionable alerts, recommendations, dashboards, and workflows.
* Build AI-assisted or agentic experiences that help users investigate data questions and operational issues, with appropriate permissions, traceability, safety checks, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Develop evaluation infrastructure for automated recommendations and actions, including reproducible tests, measurable quality criteria, regression checks, and monitoring for failures or unintended behavior.
* Improve how teams discover, validate, govern, and operate data products, reducing toil while preserving clear ownership and reliable controls.
* Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, Experimentation, ML, product, and infrastructure teams to understand needs and deliver reusable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Own production readiness for your work: instrumentation, service health, rollout plans, incident response, and follow-through on reliability and usability improvements.
* Lead technical design for projects or workstreams, communicate tradeoffs and risks clearly, and mentor engineers through reviews and collaborative problem-solving.

**You have**
------------

* Strong software engineering experience building and operating production systems, platforms, or developer tools.
* Experience designing services or frameworks that are reused by multiple teams, with attention to reliability, maintainability, observability, and user experience.
* Experience with data systems or operational workflows, for example, metadata, data quality, lineage, orchestration, monitoring, or large-scale pipeline operations.
* Sound judgment for turning ambiguous problems into incremental, measurable solutions, and for balancing automation with appropriate safeguards.
* Experience evaluating automated or AI-assisted systems using representative tests, measurable outcomes, and ongoing production feedback; familiarity with agentic workflows is especially relevant.
* The ability to collaborate across engineering and data disciplines, influence technical decisions, and explain complex tradeoffs to varied audiences.
* A track record of mentoring peers and raising engineering quality without relying on formal authority.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**.

$243,290—$295,250 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

jobs.title: CAD Automation and ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Are you passionate about designing the world's most advanced silicon? Do you want to write software that helps create the next generation of processors and enable the next remarkable Apple innovation? If so, we invite you to consider joining our team at Apple. We seek an engineer with a passion for hardware and strong programming and collaboration skills. You will gain hands-on experience in applying machine learning to circuit design automation and the reuse of custom intellectual property (IP). You will develop innovative pipelines to enable design engineers to efficiently drive and interact with their transistor-level analysis workflows, delivering diverse IPs to our numerous cutting-edge integrated circuits (ICs) in development. In this role, you will acquire a broad spectrum of knowledge spanning various disciplines and stages of silicon IP development, including applications in machine learning (ML) and large language model (LLM) technologies. These LLM applications encompass tasks such as information retrieval, triage, and chatbot development, alongside traditional silicon design areas such as transistor-level extraction, timing analysis, static/dynamic IR analysis, simulations, power EM analysis, signal EM analysis, logic equivalency checks (LEC), and signoff. The successful candidate will thrive in dynamic, collaborative environments and demonstrate a hands-on, enthusiastic, and self-motivated approach. They will possess a strong drive to succeed in challenging settings and be eager to tackle challenges with innovative solutions. If you are passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences and paying meticulous attention to detail, this role may be the perfect fit for you. As a member of our team, your contributions will directly impact the experiences of millions of Apple customers by delivering state-of-the-art processors to the diverse range of Apple products.
  
  
Description
  
  
In this highly visible role, your primary responsibilities will include: • Developing innovative ML and large language model applications to understand, explain, and interact with advanced circuit design software systems. Designing and implementing their interaction with our extensive compute infrastructure. • Identifying opportunities for optimizing, expediting, and reusing the delivery of hardware IP assets. • Actively involving yourself in supporting various ML and large language model development processes, including understanding input data, troubleshooting output, resolving software challenges that may impact project timelines, and delivering solutions to our internal customers. • Closely collaborating with diverse design teams, including Custom Digital, Analog, Mixed-Signal, and more, to understand their needs and requirements for various ML and large language model applications. Applying advanced techniques to address these requirements across multiple products and reduce duplicate design work. • Working in tandem with other experts in CAD to validate their ML-based applications, implement enhancements, and evaluate external vendor packages and solutions from EDA (Electronic Design Automation) providers and open-source.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* BS in Computer Science or related field and 3+ years of relevant industry experience

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience in developing object-oriented programs, utilizing data structures, and writing algorithms. Python is preferred. Perl is useful.
* Experience in writing machine learning algorithms, implementing natural language processing (NLP), or using large language models in industry applications
* Knowledge of transistor-level electrical engineering and related software tools for circuit analysis, such as simulation, timing, EM/IR, layout, extraction, or power analysis
* Day-to-day experience working with the UNIX shell environment and code revision control systems
* Experience leading industry software development projects
* Experience in electrical engineering machine learning applications
* Experience with large language models, including fine-tuning, retrieval augmented generation, and prompt engineering
* Experience with server management, and parallel computing platforms such as LSF, NC, AWS, etc.
* Experience creating web technologies using React, REST APIs, and equivalent
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Experience in development of large scale software systems in multi-user, multi-site environments
* Ability to drive small software development team to develop novel and complex applications

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Container Infrastructure (Technical Leadership)
jobs.description:
Meta's container platform runs a large share of the services that power Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Meta's AI products. The Containers team builds and runs the node-level software that starts, isolates, networks, and manages these workloads across a global fleet of millions of machines. We help Meta use its hardware efficiently through multi-tenancy, support new hardware including AI accelerator platforms, and build the next generation of our container runtime. We work closely with Meta's Linux kernel, networking, capacity engineering, and AI infrastructure teams. Many of the problems we solve exist nowhere else at this scale. We're looking for a Technical Lead to set the technical direction for three core areas: resource isolation, container networking, and the long-term evolution of our container runtime. You'll define the multi-year architecture, make key design decisions, mentor a team of systems engineers, stay hands-on in the most critical code, and influence partner teams across the infrastructure organization.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Container Infrastructure (Technical Leadership) Responsibilities:**

* Set technical strategy and roadmap for container resource isolation, networking, and runtime architecture
* Design isolation mechanisms for densely packed multi-tenant hosts that manage contention across CPU, memory, I/O, and network, using cgroup v2 and other kernel primitives
* Lead the architecture of container networking across diverse workloads and hardware, including network namespaces, eBPF-based datapaths, and network isolation and policy
* Drive the modernization of the container runtime toward a modular, standards-aligned (OCI) architecture that improves scalability, reliability and deployment safety
* Plan and carry out safe, incremental migrations across a very large production fleet
* Partner with kernel, networking, hardware, and capacity teams to shape new platform capabilities
* Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical coaching, and raise the team's engineering and operational standards
* Write and present technical proposals that build alignment across teams and organizations

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.description:
### **Who we are**

Gatik is in the business of autonomous freight, and that business is already on the road.

Every day, Gatik's autonomous trucks move freight for Fortune 50 retailers, grocers and consumer brands across Texas, Arizona, Arkansas and Canada, connecting distribution centers and stores and keeping goods moving. At the heart of it all is the Gatik Driver™, our proprietary Level 4 autonomous driving system, powered by scalable, interpretable AI and engineered to deliver safe, reliable, high-frequency freight operations.

Gatik's momentum is real. With more than $600 million in contracted revenue and $200 million raised in our August 2026 Series D round, Gatik has taken one of the toughest challenges in autonomous technology and turned it into a proven commercial business.

And the market is paying attention. In 2026, Gatik earned a place on Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers list, and the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. The Gatik Driver™ won an Edison Award for Advancements in Autonomous Driving, and Inc. named our Co-founder and Chief Engineer, Apeksha Kumavat, to its Female Founders 500 list.

There's a lot more road ahead, and some of the brightest, most driven minds in autonomous technology are building the next chapter at Gatik. We're taking on hard engineering problems, pushing the limits of what's possible and building on a commercial foundation that's already proven itself in the real world with some of the biggest companies in the world, like PepsiCo and Loblaw. If you're ambitious, love solving problems that matter and want to see your work make a real difference, you'll find plenty to get excited about here.

**About the Team**

Scaling our machine learning models with data and fast infrastructure is central to how Gatik's autonomy stack keeps improving. The Scalable ML team builds the data generation, curation, orchestration, and distributed training infrastructure that lets our ML developers work efficiently with large volumes of real-world fleet data and simulated driving scenarios. The team sits at the intersection of ML Platform, Jobs Platform, Cloud Platform, and High Performance Computing, and partners closely with Gatik's autonomy, simulation, safety, and data teams.

**About the Role**

As a Senior or Staff engineer on Scalable ML, you'll design and build the systems that turn raw driving data from Gatik's fleet into high-quality training and evaluation sets, run training and evaluation reliably at scale, and give engineers the metrics and tools they need to make confident release decisions for driverless operations. At the Staff level, you'll also set multi-quarter technical direction and act as a technical bridge across teams that don't report to you.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build scalable data pipelines.** Design and maintain reproducible pipelines that discover, label, and organize driving scenarios from Gatik's fleet and simulation, with versioning, provenance, well-designed train/validation/holdout splits, and clear data contracts.
* **Curate high-quality datasets.** Build balanced training and evaluation sets that cover the scenarios our trucks encounter across routes, weather, and traffic conditions, and analyze coverage, composition, and label quality to shape dataset and model priorities.
* **Scale training and evaluation infrastructure.** Build distributed training, inference, and evaluation pipelines with robust data loading, checkpointing, and experiment tracking that run smoothly on multi-tenant GPU clusters.
* **Drive MLOps best practices.** Implement model artifact management, experiment tracking, and automated model testing and deployment at a standard other teams across Gatik adopt.
* **Own the metrics.** Define, implement, and validate model and release metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC AUC, calibration, and task-specific metrics) with the statistical rigor that safety-critical release decisions demand, and characterize how behavior evolves across software releases and scenario types.
* **Run thoughtful experiments.** Set up baselines, ablations, and holdout comparisons; quantify uncertainty; and communicate results that help the autonomy team decide with confidence.
* **Build tools engineers love.** Develop dashboards and services for comparing software versions, exploring results at the scenario level, visualizing model outputs, and gathering reviewer feedback.
* **Shape shared infrastructure.** Partner with ML Platform, Jobs Platform, Cloud Platform, and HPC engineers to design and review changes to GPU scheduling and quota, job orchestration, storage, and compute cost.
* **Raise the engineering and reliability bar.** Design clean interfaces between data, modeling, and product layers; champion testing, type checking, code review, and fast CI; and lead root-causing and prevention of incidents, including those that cross team boundaries.
* **Lead technically (Staff).** Define and drive multi-quarter technical strategy for data and training infrastructure, represent Scalable ML in architecture discussions, and mentor engineers across the team.

**What You'll Need to Succeed**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant industry experience (or a Master's degree and 3+ years). Staff candidates typically bring 8+ years, including time setting technical direction beyond a single team.
* Strong Python software engineering skills, including designing modular, maintainable, high-performance, well-tested systems in a shared codebase.
* Experience building end-to-end ML systems, from data pipelines and dataset curation through training, evaluation, and production, using tools such as SQL, pandas, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
* Hands-on production experience with Ray (Ray Core, Ray Data, Ray Train, and/or Ray Tune), including running and debugging Ray workloads at scale.
* Deep experience with PyTorch and PyTorch

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Love using AI to solve big, messy problems that actually move a business? Join Sales AI as an Applied Scientist and own the science behind how Amazon Ads helps every advertiser grow, from understanding where each brand is on its growth journey to building the GenAI agents account teams use every day.  
  
Advertising is one of the fastest growing parts of our business, and science sits at the heart of how we help brands succeed. Our scientists work on two connected problems. The first is figuring out, for each brand, the smartest next step it can take to grow, and turning that into a clear, personalized recommendation. The second is building LLM-powered assistants and agents that put that intelligence into the hands of the people who work with those brands, accurately and at scale. If you want real ownership, hard problems, and models that ship, we'd love to talk.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll own production science systems that account teams rely on every day. For example, you might build the recommendation engine that maps where each advertiser is in their growth journey and what their best next step is, or improve the accuracy of the LLM-powered assistants and agents that account teams use to prepare for and run customer conversations. Day to day that means:  
  

* Turn ambiguous business problems into well-defined science problems, and choose the right approach to solve them
* Build, ship, and continuously improve models in production, and own their quality once they launch
* Measure whether our models really move the business, through A/B tests, causal analysis, and offline evaluation
* Partner with engineers and product managers to take ideas from early research into production
* Set the technical direction for your area, raise the scientific bar, and mentor other scientists
* Explain complex methods and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners, and sales leaders

  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might start by testing a new modeling approach, then review evaluation results with engineers to decide whether a model is ready to launch. Later you could meet with product partners to agree on what to build next, or dig into data to understand why a recommendation isn't landing. Your customers are the account teams who work directly with brands, and the brands themselves, who rely on your work to decide where to invest and how to grow.  
  
About the team  
Sales AI is a central science and data engineering organization within Amazon Advertising Sales. Our mission is to power selling motions and account team workflows with state-of-the-art AI and ML services. We build advertiser insights, recommendations, and generative AI-powered applications woven throughout account team workflows. We care about a high scientific bar, real business impact, and taking ideas all the way into production. Most of all, we like working with curious people who want to drive real, lasting impact for our customers.

------------------------

* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in building machine learning models for business application
* Experience with one of the following areas: machine learning technologies, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) or related applications

* Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning
* Applied research experience in Reinforcement Learning (RLHF, policy gradient methods), Large Language Models (fine-tuning, guardrails, distributed training) and/or Natural Language Processing

jobs.description:
### **About Anyware Robotics**

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

### **Description**

About Anyware

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

The Role

The robots run on **AnywareOS**, our industrial physical intelligence system. Its architecture is modular and designed to generalize across applications without reprogramming. We are seeking a **Sr. AI Perception Engineer** to advance Anyware's production 3D AI perception stack for warehouse automation robots, with a focus on object localization, pose estimation, scene reconstruction, and deployment on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.

This role is for an engineer who builds AI perception that works on real sensor data and physical systems — not only on benchmarks — and who wants to take it through production and real-world operation. You will own perception capabilities end to end within your area — problem definition, model and pipeline development, deployment on robot hardware, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement — and make pragmatic tradeoffs across accuracy, reliability, latency, compute, data, maintainability, engineering effort, and delivery timelines.

This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will own the design decisions in your area, contribute to architecture and design reviews, and work closely with the Perception Team Lead and Staff engineers who set technical direction across the perception stack.

What you'll do

* **Build 3D AI perception on physical systems, hands-on** — develop robust object localization, pose estimation, and scene reconstruction models and pipelines using RGB-D and other sensing modalities, running on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.
* **Own perception capabilities end to end** — from problem definition and prototyping through deployment, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement within Anyware's existing perception stack.
* **Improve perception reliability on physical robots** — diagnose and fix failures caused by difficult scenes, changing lighting, sensor noise, and gaps between training data and customer environments.
* **Strengthen production readiness** — better data, evaluation, regression testing, release criteria, observability, and systematic root-cause analysis of field failures.
* **Make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs across the robot system** — balance accuracy, robustness, latency, compute cost, data availability, maintainability, and delivery timelines while integrating perception reliably with planning, manipulation, controls, and system software.

Required Skills

* BS, MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Vision, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **3+** years of professional experience developing **AI perception systems** for physical robots or comparable real-world machines.
* **Hands-on proficiency building AI perception models** (PyTorch or similar) and real-time perception pipelines in Python and C++.

Nice to have

* Experience deploying and operating AI perception in production on physical robots — running models under latency and compute constraints on robot hardware and owning reliability in the field.
* Strong foundation in 3D geometry, camera models and calibration, RGB-D or point-cloud processing, and 3D object localization, segmentation, or pose estimation.
* Experience with ROS or ROS2 for real-time robotic perception pipelines, including sensor-data processing and model integration.
* Experience deploying robotic perception systems in warehouse, logistics, or other industrial environments.

Why Anyware

* **An A+ Team:** Anyware is built by top talents. Collectively, our team has won six Best Paper Awards and Finalists, including the ICRA 2025 Best Paper Award and ICRA 2024 Best Paper Award.
* **An A+ Robot:** Our robot, Pixmo, won the Best Innovation Award (top-1) at both ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026 — the two largest logistics automation exhibitions in the world. Pixmo also won the RBR50 Robotics Innovation Award.
* **Real Impact:** Your perception work does not stop at a demo. It ships into real customer sites, directly affects robot reliability and throughput, and must perform under real-world variation.
* **Fast Growth:** You will have strong ownership and real responsibility in a growing robotics company.
* **Generous Equity:** We offer generous equity in addition to salary and benefits.

The expected salary range for this role is 150K-240K USD/year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional compensation may include equity, benefits, or other incentives, where applicable.

Benefits & Perks

* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid sick leave
* 401(k) plan support
* Daily meal credit

jobs.description:
**San Francisco, CA · Hybrid · Full-time**  
**Compensation:** $180K to $250K base

### **About the Company**

Our client is a well-funded, early-stage company backed by top-tier investors, building an ad network designed for AI-native products. Traditional banner and video ads do not work inside conversational interfaces, so they have built ad formats and targeting made for GenAI environments: publishers monetize free users without hurting the experience, and advertisers reach high-intent users one-to-one. The team is small, scrappy and builder-focused, with strong ties to the indie developer and founder community.

Founded 2024 · ~20 people · Industry: Ad Tech, AI, Marketing

### **The Role**

You would join a backend engineering team of five to six people as the sixth or seventh engineer. The work is broad and ownership is high: you take ambiguous business problems, such as improving return on ad spend, break them into projects you lead, and ship them. The core systems are a real-time auction and ad-decisioning pipeline, the data models underneath it, and the abstractions that define what an ad can be inside a conversation.

**What you'll be doing**

* Ship foundational backend code and own production services from design through operation
* Build and evolve relational data models and schemas for transactional systems
* Design the abstractions behind new ad formats for conversational AI
* Improve the real-time auction and ad-selection systems that drive publisher revenue
* Work across the stack where needed; there is no rigid team split

**Tech stack:** Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Kafka, Python, TypeScript, React, Terraform, AWS, Tailscale, Cloudflare

### **Requirements**

* A track record of owning backend services end to end, having carried them through the full development lifecycle more than once
* At least 3 years as a backend engineer, with the kind of production ownership typically found at the senior level
* Solid relational data modeling and schema design on transactional databases, with strong SQL and the ability to debug data issues
* Hands-on experience with some combination of Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, React and TypeScript
* Exposure to analytics or OLAP databases (ClickHouse or similar) or infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform
* Comfort operating on AWS with a modern observability setup (Grafana-family tooling or similar)

### **Nice to Haves**

* Time at an early-stage startup, as a founder or an early engineer
* Background in ad tech, real-time bidding or auction systems, or low-latency work at a trading firm
* A degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field

### **Why Join**

* Build core infrastructure for how AI products get monetized, at a company with significant funding and top-tier backing
* Join a small, highly experienced engineering team that moves fast and values craft
* Own foundational systems with real autonomy rather than a narrow slice
* Work on hard, low-latency problems whose impact shows up directly in customer revenue

### **Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco, CA
* **Work policy:** Hybrid, roughly four days a week in the San Francisco office
* **Compensation:** $180K to $250K base
* **Visa sponsorship:** Available, including visa transfers (OPT, H-1B) and new sponsorship (H-1B, TN)
* **Employment type:** Full-time

Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As a Senior Software Engineer on our storage team, you'll be joining our core engineering team to design, build, and optimize our next-generation cloud storage products. We're looking for a hands-on engineer with deep expertise in building storage systems. You will be responsible for building highly performant, reliable, and scalable distributed storage systems that are critical to our infrastructure and our customers' AI/HPC workloads.

  + Building core components of our foundational storage products, purpose built for high performance AI and ML workloads
  + Contributing to distributed file, block and object storage products, with a focus on filesystem based solutions

  + Design and implement high-performance, scalable, and resilient storage architectures that are highly extensible
  + Proposing and prototyping novel strategies to scale performance and system throughput for our most demanding customer workloads

### **About Zipline**

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

* Mentor and elevate the team: set standards for testing, dbt CI/CD, production monitoring, and runbooks; onboard and review work from junior analytics engineers.

The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems that power many of Apple’s customer-facing services - including iCloud, iTunes, Siri and Maps. We deliver the core infrastructure primitives that enable teams across Apple to build services our customers rely on every day. This is a ground-up effort to build a highly reliable, self-managing and scalable storage layer that can support exabyte-scale data and diverse access patterns. This new layer will also serve as the foundation for adopting and optimizing next-generation storage devices, enabling Apple to leverage emerging drive technologies with new performance and density characteristics. If you enjoy designing distributed systems that operate as a cohesive storage fabric, we want to hear from you.

Engineers on this team will work on the core of a unified storage layer designed to manage data objects, placement, redundancy and IO operations across thousands of nodes. You will help define the fundamental building blocks that unify different storage backends—object, block and future file interfaces—behind a single, extensible abstraction. You will design consistent metadata services, build scalable data distribution algorithms, implement robust replication and fault-recovery mechanisms, and develop client-side libraries and protocols that expose a uniform interface to workloads across Apple. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Map Infrastructure
jobs.description:
### **Who we are**

Gatik is in the business of autonomous freight, and that business is already on the road.

Every day, Gatik's autonomous trucks move freight for Fortune 50 retailers, grocers and consumer brands across Texas, Arizona, Arkansas and Canada, connecting distribution centers and stores and keeping goods moving. At the heart of it all is the Gatik Driver™, our proprietary Level 4 autonomous driving system, powered by scalable, interpretable AI and engineered to deliver safe, reliable, high-frequency freight operations.

Gatik's momentum is real. With more than $600 million in contracted revenue and $200 million raised in our August 2026 Series D round, Gatik has taken one of the toughest challenges in autonomous technology and turned it into a proven commercial business.

And the market is paying attention. In 2026, Gatik earned a place on Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers list, and the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. The Gatik Driver™ won an Edison Award for Advancements in Autonomous Driving, and Inc. named our Co-founder and Chief Engineer, Apeksha Kumavat, to its Female Founders 500 list.

There's a lot more road ahead, and some of the brightest, most driven minds in autonomous technology are building the next chapter at Gatik. We're taking on hard engineering problems, pushing the limits of what's possible and building on a commercial foundation that's already proven itself in the real world with some of the biggest companies in the world, like PepsiCo and Loblaw. If you're ambitious, love solving problems that matter and want to see your work make a real difference, you'll find plenty to get excited about here.

**About the Team**

Maps are a foundation of Gatik's autonomy stack, supporting localization, perception, prediction, planning, and simulation. The Map Infrastructure team builds the systems that turn fleet sensor data into accurate, versioned, validated maps and deliver them reliably to every truck and every simulation run. Because Gatik grows by launching new customer routes, how fast and safely we can map, validate, and deploy a new route directly shapes how fast the business scales.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer on Map Infrastructure, you'll design and build the pipelines, storage, services, and tools behind Gatik's maps, from raw sensor logs to the map data our trucks load on the road. You'll work closely with localization, autonomy, simulation, and operations teams to make map creation faster, map quality measurable, and map updates safe to ship.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build map creation pipelines.** Design and scale pipelines that process lidar, camera, and GNSS/IMU data from the fleet into high-definition maps, including alignment, semantic layer generation, and automated and human-in-the-loop labeling.
* **Speed up route onboarding.** Reduce the time and cost to map, validate, and deploy new customer routes and hubs through automation, better tooling, and clear process.
* **Own map storage and versioning.** Build the geospatial data platform that stores map data with versioning, provenance, and clear schemas and data contracts, so every truck and simulation run can trace exactly which map it used.
* **Deliver maps to the vehicle.** Build reliable, efficient services that package, compress, and distribute map updates to the fleet, with safe rollout, rollback, and compatibility guarantees for onboard software.
* **Detect and manage map change.** Build systems that use fleet data to detect real-world changes such as construction, lane changes, and new signage, and route them into fast, safe map updates.
* **Make map quality measurable.** Define and implement map quality metrics and automated validation checks for geometry, topology, semantics, and localization performance, and gate releases on them.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

The HR Product Engineering team is the foundational layer of Rippling's unified workforce management system. Our mission is to build seamless, global, and compliant systems that power the entire employee lifecycle, from hire to retire.

* Exposure and hands on experience with systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**About Sycamore**
==================

Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need.

We are a small, engineering-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders.

**The role**
============

You own the business result of a customer engagement from the first conversation with the customer through to the expansion that follows. Our Applied AI engineers own the technical result: the workflow runs, the agent behaves, the integration holds under production load. You own everything around it. The engagement lands in scope and on the date, the value it created is measured in numbers the customer already trusts, and their leadership knows what to build next.

You work as a pair with the engineer on every deployment, and with the account executive on everything above it. You program manage the work day to day, you build the map of the customer’s organization, and you are the person who says a use case is too large for a first release or that a go-live date does not survive the resourcing behind it. That is unpopular work, and it is most of what protects a deployment. You do not carry a quota. You are expected to know the heartbeat of the account better than anyone else at Sycamore.

**Why this role exists**
========================

A pilot that works technically and then dies quietly is the most common failure in enterprise AI. The agent runs, the demo goes well, and nine months later nobody can say what changed in the operating numbers, so the renewal conversation restarts from zero.

Our engineers deploy fast, and that speed creates a second job. Someone has to agree what success means before the build starts, keep the first release small enough to reach production, measure the result the way the customer’s own finance and operations teams measure things, and turn one working workflow into the next five. That is this role.

**What you will do**
====================

* Work the opportunity with the account executive before it closes: discovery, process walkthroughs, and a first release you would be willing to put your own name on.
* Write the success criteria into the agreement: what gets measured, against what baseline, by when, and who on the customer’s side signs that it happened.
* Program manage pilots and full implementations end to end: scope, resourcing, dependencies, milestones, go-live dates, and the weekly rhythm that keeps all of it honest.
* Agree the business case before the build starts. Set the baseline, the metric, and the measurement method with the customer in writing, while there is still time to instrument it.
* Measure and publish the outcome in the customer’s own terms: hours returned, cycle time, exception rates, cost per case, whatever their operating reviews already track.
* Hold scope against pressure from both sides, and protect the engineer’s ability to ship something that works.
* Build and maintain the account map with the account executive: processes, owners, budget holders, adjacent teams, and the politics between them.
* Produce the ranked list of use cases and product capabilities the customer should take on next, each one sized, sponsored, and tied to a business owner.
* Make the call on what should not be automated at all, and be able to defend it to the customer’s sponsor and to our engineers.
* Bring a point of view to roadmap conversations. When the same need shows up across three accounts, make the case that it belongs in the product roadmap.
* Hand expansion to the account executive with the evidence already assembled, and stay in the room for that conversation.
* Feed the field back into product: which use cases repeat across customers, where measurement is hard, and what keeps deployments from reaching production.

**What this role is not**
=========================

* It is not a customer success role that begins at go-live and reports on adoption.
* It is not project management without a point of view on what should be built.
* It is not a quota-carrying sales role. You do not own the number, though you own most of what makes the number possible.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 6+ years in enterprise program delivery, consulting, value engineering, customer success leadership, or a deployment role at an enterprise software company. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Container Infrastructure (Technical Leadership)
jobs.description:
Meta's container platform runs a large share of the services that power Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Meta's AI products. The Containers team builds and runs the node-level software that starts, isolates, networks, and manages these workloads across a global fleet of millions of machines. We help Meta use its hardware efficiently through multi-tenancy, support new hardware including AI accelerator platforms, and build the next generation of our container runtime. We work closely with Meta's Linux kernel, networking, capacity engineering, and AI infrastructure teams. Many of the problems we solve exist nowhere else at this scale. We're looking for a Technical Lead to set the technical direction for three core areas: resource isolation, container networking, and the long-term evolution of our container runtime. You'll define the multi-year architecture, make key design decisions, mentor a team of systems engineers, stay hands-on in the most critical code, and influence partner teams across the infrastructure organization.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Container Infrastructure (Technical Leadership) Responsibilities:**

* Set technical strategy and roadmap for container resource isolation, networking, and runtime architecture
* Design isolation mechanisms for densely packed multi-tenant hosts that manage contention across CPU, memory, I/O, and network, using cgroup v2 and other kernel primitives
* Lead the architecture of container networking across diverse workloads and hardware, including network namespaces, eBPF-based datapaths, and network isolation and policy
* Drive the modernization of the container runtime toward a modular, standards-aligned (OCI) architecture that improves scalability, reliability and deployment safety
* Plan and carry out safe, incremental migrations across a very large production fleet
* Partner with kernel, networking, hardware, and capacity teams to shape new platform capabilities
* Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical coaching, and raise the team's engineering and operational standards
* Write and present technical proposals that build alignment across teams and organizations

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Deep knowledge of Linux internals relevant to containers, such as cgroups, namespaces, process management, and resource accounting
* Experience leading technical direction for a team and delivering complex, multi-quarter infrastructure projects
* Experience designing and running large-scale distributed or fleet-wide infrastructures in production
* Experience communicating technical decisions in writing and in presentations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and influencing direction across teams through proposals and stakeholder alignment

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience running fleet-wide migrations or rollouts with strong safety and observability practices
* Hands-on eBPF experience, especially for networking (TC, XDP, cgroup hooks) or observability
* Background in Linux networking, such as virtual network devices, routing, and packet path performance tuning
* Experience with container runtimes and ecosystems such as OCI, runc/crun, containerd, Kubernetes node components, or systemd
* Experience with performance isolation in multi-tenant environments, such as CPU scheduling, memory pressure management, I/O control and PSI
* Contributions to the Linux kernel or open-source container and networking projects

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Sales AI
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Love using AI to solve big, messy problems that actually move a business? Join Sales AI as an Applied Scientist and own the science behind how Amazon Ads helps every advertiser grow, from understanding where each brand is on its growth journey to building the GenAI agents account teams use every day.  
  
Advertising is one of the fastest growing parts of our business, and science sits at the heart of how we help brands succeed. Our scientists work on two connected problems. The first is figuring out, for each brand, the smartest next step it can take to grow, and turning that into a clear, personalized recommendation. The second is building LLM-powered assistants and agents that put that intelligence into the hands of the people who work with those brands, accurately and at scale. If you want real ownership, hard problems, and models that ship, we'd love to talk.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll own production science systems that account teams rely on every day. For example, you might build the recommendation engine that maps where each advertiser is in their growth journey and what their best next step is, or improve the accuracy of the LLM-powered assistants and agents that account teams use to prepare for and run customer conversations. Day to day that means:  
  

* Turn ambiguous business problems into well-defined science problems, and choose the right approach to solve them
* Build, ship, and continuously improve models in production, and own their quality once they launch
* Measure whether our models really move the business, through A/B tests, causal analysis, and offline evaluation
* Partner with engineers and product managers to take ideas from early research into production
* Set the technical direction for your area, raise the scientific bar, and mentor other scientists
* Explain complex methods and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners, and sales leaders

  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might start by testing a new modeling approach, then review evaluation results with engineers to decide whether a model is ready to launch. Later you could meet with product partners to agree on what to build next, or dig into data to understand why a recommendation isn't landing. Your customers are the account teams who work directly with brands, and the brands themselves, who rely on your work to decide where to invest and how to grow.  
  
About the team  
Sales AI is a central science and data engineering organization within Amazon Advertising Sales. Our mission is to power selling motions and account team workflows with state-of-the-art AI and ML services. We build advertiser insights, recommendations, and generative AI-powered applications woven throughout account team workflows. We care about a high scientific bar, real business impact, and taking ideas all the way into production. Mercor is defining the future of work. We partner with leading AI labs and enterprises to provide the human intelligence essential to AI development.

Our vast talent network trains frontier AI models in the same way teachers teach students: by sharing knowledge, experience, and context that can't be captured in code alone. Today, more than 30,000 experts in our network collectively earn over $2 million a day.

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society.

Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our new San Francisco headquarters.

**About the Role**  
Frontier AI companies are increasingly bottlenecked on expert judgment and high-quality data workflows. This team builds the production systems that capture, coordinate, and validate that work at scale — directly between a customer request and the output that ships.  
These are long-running, stateful systems. A single job can stay live for days, interleaving automated steps, model inference, and expert review. A step marked "done" can be reopened, re-reviewed, and redone — so "completed" is not always final, state has to tolerate late mutation, and correctness has to survive humans and models disagreeing with each other.  
This is a backend systems and orchestration problem: distributed state machines, not pipelines. The architecture is not set. Early engineers will decide what it becomes, and the loop between "I shipped this" and "this mattered" is short.  
**What You'll Do**

* Design services and state models for multi-stage workflows that fan out across automated processing and expert reviewers, then reconcile results into a coherent whole
* Build orchestration primitives — retries, failure recovery, idempotency, auditable state transitions — for jobs that run far longer than a request and can be partially redone after the fact
* Integrate model inference into production workflows without sacrificing debuggability or human oversight
* Build the APIs and tooling that let product, operations, and ML teams operate, debug, and trust these systems at scale
* Own reliability and observability for workflows where a silent failure means a corrupted result, not just a 500  
  **What Makes This Role Different**
* You are building the core infrastructure that sits directly between customer requests and the outputs that ship — not internal tooling, not a support system
* This product area is young and strategically central; early engineers are deciding the architecture, not inheriting it
* The inputs are non-deterministic by nature — you are building durable orchestration over humans and models that can disagree with each other on hour 40 of a multi-stage job  
  **Day-to-Day**
* Moving fast on genuinely hard systems problems — ambiguity is the default, not the exception
* Working closely with product, operations, and ML teams to translate a tangle of constraints into clean system design
* Debugging complex stateful workflows where the failure surface spans automated steps, model calls, and human reviewers
* Owning your systems end-to-end: design, ship, operate, improve  
  **What We're Looking For**
* Production backend experience with strong opinions about what ages well and why
* Sharp instincts for system design, service boundaries, and where to put complexity — and where to refuse it
* Fluency with the distributed systems toolkit: async workflows, queues, idempotency, retries, and long-running jobs as practice, not resume line items
* Ability to take ambiguous product, operational, and ML constraints and turn them into a system that is clean and debuggable
* Comfort working in Python on AWS with Postgres; experience with Temporal or similar workflow engines is a plus  
  **You're likely someone who:**
* Gets frustrated by systems that are hard to debug and takes that personally enough to fix it
* Has strong opinions about where state should live and can defend them in a design review
* Moves fast but doesn't treat reliability as someone else's problem
* Wants your work to have a short, visible line to outcomes that actually matter to c

C++ Software Engineer – Trade Capture

**About Millennium**

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium's mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**

Information Technology is core to the health and growth of our business: the firm's active, multi-manager business model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities. Within Information Technology, the Trade Platform Engineering team builds and supports the systems that capture, process, and deliver the firm's trade and execution data.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and implement components that ingest, enrich, validate, allocate, and publish trade and execution data from electronic, voice, and manual workflows
* Build reliable, event-driven processing for trade lifecycle events, including amendments, cancellations, exercises, assignments, resets, and terminations
* Contribute to a common commissions and fees framework across asset classes, covering configurable rules, calculations, allocations, adjustments, and reconciliation
* Develop and evolve APIs, message schemas, and downstream integrations that deliver complete, accurate trade data, and contribute to future platform capabilities such as standardized interfaces, configurable workflows, and client-level entitlements and data isolation
* Help migrate business-critical workflows from legacy platforms by identifying gaps, supporting legacy coexistence and parallel runs, reconciling results, and preparing controlled cutovers
* Build operational capabilities for trade-status visibility, exception management, investigation, and correction within appropriate permissions
* Own features from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, and operational support, and contribute to improvements in performance, reliability, replay, and recovery
* Work directly with business and technology partners to understand workflows, clarify requirements, and deliver practical solutions

**What You Bring**

* Knowledge of post-trade systems and workflows, including trade capture, lifecycle processing, allocations, reconciliation, and downstream accounting or back-office integration
* 5+ years of experience developing server-side C++ applications on Linux
* Strong understanding of real-time, event-driven software, with experience building reliable, high-performance systems
* Solid knowledge of network programming, Linux internals, concurrency, memory management, object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience with SQL and relational databases
* A strong sense of ownership and attention to quality in designing, testing, and supporting production software, with the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast-moving environment with changing demands
* Clear communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve ambiguous requirements
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

**Salary Range**

Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual's experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

jobs.title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
=======================

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

**Role Description**
====================

As a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll lead the design, delivery, and ongoing optimization of automation solutions for Tennr’s most complex customers: large-scale health systems, national provider groups, and enterprise partners. This is a highly technical, strategic, and customer-facing role that demands deep domain fluency, executive presence, and strong systems thinking.

You’ll own enterprise-scale implementations end-to-end: from pre-sale discovery and business case alignment to go-live and expansion. You’ll act as both a trusted technical advisor and a project lead, working closely with senior customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams at Tennr to ensure lasting success.

This role sits within a high-performance implementation pod and directly influences Tennr’s go-to-market and product strategy.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead end-to-end enterprise implementations, from discovery to post-go-live
* Align cross-functional teams and manage project delivery, risks, and change
* Conduct operational audits to identify workflow gaps and automation opportunities
* Design scalable, configurable solutions using Tennr’s platform and APIs
* Reimagine processes with automation best practices, not just replicate legacy systems
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Sales to shape solutions and delivery scope
* Maintain documentation, enable knowledge transfer, and improve internal delivery tools
* Support sales strategy, mentor junior team members, and influence product roadmap

**Qualifications**
==================

* 4+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS delivery or solution design
* A degree or minor in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of APIs, systems integration, and technical architecture
* Proven ability to lead complex technical engagements with large enterprise customers
* Skilled at communicating technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences
* Experience navigating complex org structures and aligning cross-functional stakeholders
* Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on strategic, scalable solutions
* Business acumen and domain fluency — ideally in healthcare or similarly complex industries
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced, unstructured environments
* Demonstrated ability to mentor others and contribute to team-wide best practices
* High ownership mindset and urgency — proactive, resourceful, and impact-driven

Nice to Haves

* Familiarity with workflow automation, RPA, or enterprise integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato)
* Background in consulting, solution architecture, or technical customer success
* Experience in startup environments or scaling delivery functions

**Why Tennr?**
==============

* Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.
* Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure
* Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.
* Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week
* Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks.

**Benefits**
============

* Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street
* Unlimited PTO
* 100% paid employee health benefit options
* Employer-funded 401(k) match
* Competitive parental leave

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K
